work.title: Musik til Adam Oehlenschlägers heltedigt "Yrsa"
Music to Adam Oehlenschläger's Heroic Poem "Yrsa"

event.desc: A Gala performance celebrating Hartmann's 80th birthday.

history.p: Adam Oehlenschläger wrote his tragedy "Yrsa" in 1814, but it was not until 1880 - thirty years after his death - that The Royal Theatre decided to stage it. Hartmann was asked to compose the music, and it became his last major work in the so-called Nordic style, which had meant so much in his oeuvre. The tragedy was not performed with Hartmann's music until three years later.

incipText.p: O skjønne Borg! Hist kneiser den med sine Spir
En sælsom Følelse, Reigin besjæler mig
En Hyrdepige nærmer sig med hviden Spand
Gid denne Drik maa styrke Dig
Med langsom List Flodernes Dronning hævner Ymerkæmpe
Saa seile vi Hjem ved Medbørsvind

physDesc.physMedium: In half binding; green cloth with green leather on spine. Stamped in gold on the spine the monogram of King Christian X and: "I.P.E. / HARTMANN / YRSA". Written in purple and black ink with a few corrections and emendations in pencil. Paper: 20 staves. Sporadic pagination with numerous corrections above the music. Consecutively paginated below the music. At the end of the overture on p. 45 dated "13 Septbr. 1881." At the end of the music on p. 140 dated and signed "6/3 82. / I:P:E:Hartmann."
A loose folio paginated 6-7. Written in black ink. Paper: 20 staves. Both pages crossed out.
